ioctl_observation.fd_lifecycle_scope: opaque file IDs assigned at observed open/openat/openat2 and dup/dup2/dup3/fcntl(F_DUPFD*) calls; close() removes an ID; close_range invalidates affected IDs; exec invalidates inherited IDs; io_uring and external fd injection are not tracked; VMA file references remain kernel-owned
ioctl_observation.object_class_resolution_scope: successful prior RM_ALLOC and RM_FREE packets observed on the explicitly selected control and GPU paths; keyed by root and handle; unresolved means no unique live object was observed
ioctl_observation.payload_scope: exact pinned R580 NVOS33 map wrapper and NVOS34 unmap packet, selected-device open/dup/close/mmap metadata, and transient RM_ALLOC/RM_FREE class resolution; no allocation payloads emitted; addresses, paths, and handles omitted
ioctl_observation.snapshot_consistency: per-task syscall stop; other threads may mutate shared packet memory
